messages:
maya: FYI customer on private VPC (acme corp) opened a billing dispute — their invoice shows ~3.2M tokens but the private metering dashboard shows 2.1M. they say audit logs show ~3.1M. can someone triage?

jordan: tagging in — do we know which agent version they're running and whether the agent was ever offline/queued? common cause is buffering + dropped events when disk quota hits.

maya: customer says agent v0.9.3, deployed on a VM with intermittent outbound restrictions. they mentioned a recent host reboot around 2026-02-15 03:12 UTC.

priya: with invoicing diffs I want both the raw meter events + their audit logs for the same window. maya can you get us: 1) sample request ids, 2) a tarball of /var/log/redwood-meter.log for the window, 3) agent config (upload_interval, max_batch_size)?

maya: already asked customer for those. they sent a snippet from the agent log showing repeated lines: `WARN: buffer overflow, dropped 142 events` and a few `sync failed, connection timeout`. pasted below.

maya: ```
2026-02-15T03:11:45Z WARN buffer size=1048576 used=1048576 dropped=142
2026-02-15T03:11:46Z ERROR upload failed: dial tcp 10.12.8.5:443: i/o timeout
2026-02-15T03:12:01Z INFO agent restarted (systemd)
```

li: that buffer line + restart is suspicious. if buffer overflow happened, events are dropped permanently unless offline buffering persists to disk. which storage backend is configured? the older default used an in-memory ring buffer (pre-1.0) and loses events on restart.

jordan: also check clock skew. if the agent clock is ahead of the control plane, events might appear outside reconciliation windows and be ignored by dedupe/ingest. ask customer to run `date -u` and `ntpq -p`.

priya: for billing, we reconcile meter events with invoice aggregation by event timestamp after normalizing to UTC. skew >5m can cause perplexing gaps. but dropped events will always undercount the meter vs audit log. audit log is server-side and should reflect all accepted requests.

maya: customer ran `date -u` and got `Sun Feb 15 03:12:03 UTC 2026` which matches control plane, ntp shows one stray stratum 16 peer — so clock drift possible. they also attached the agent config: `upload_interval: 30s, max_batch_size: 10k, persist_to_disk: false`

li: persist_to_disk=false explains lost events on restart. combined with intermittent egress, buffer overflow happened and then restart nuked memory queue. that's our primary hypothesis.

jordan: next steps: 1) ask customer to flip `persist_to_disk: true` and bump upload_interval -> 60s while we stabilize egress. 2) we should reprocess any agent-side logs we received to produce a best-effort reconciliation. 3) billing team to flag invoice as disputed until we complete reconciliation.

priya: agree. I'll put a temporary credit hold and open a billing dispute. need the sample request ids and the tarball to run reconciliation.

maya: customer sent sample IDs: `req_8a9f`, `req_d3c2`, `req_f1b0`. attaching the gzipped log in the support ticket (not in slack).

li: small repro: simulate by running agent with `persist_to_disk=false` and kill -9 after buffer fills. command: `./redwood-meter-agent --config agent.yaml & sleep 20; kill -9 $!` will show dropped counts locally. also check `/metrics` endpoint: `meter_events_dropped_total` and `meter_buffer_usage_bytes`.

jordan: can eng-runtime add a temporary ingest-mode that accepts out-of-window events for reconciliation? if events were timestamped slightly beyond our window we should still be able to credit them for billing.

priya: yes please. for dispute resolution I need a reconciliation CSV: timestamp, request_id, tokens_reported, source (agent|audit).

maya: I've told the customer to enable persist_to_disk and increase upload_interval, and to open an outbound rule to our egress IPs for 443. they're ok with the config change; want to know ETA to run reconciliation.

li: I can process the log tarball today and output a best-effort CSV. give me write access to the billing bucket.

priya: granting access now. please put results in `s3://redwood-billing/disputes/acme-20260215/` and ping me when done. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: incident created: INC-2026-1143 (billing-dispute-acme). severity: P2. assignees: priya, li.

maya: thanks all — keeping this thread for notes. will update once reconciliation is uploaded and billing actioned. :white_check_mark:
